label: Shift registers
subgoals: Double the register value and add the serial input bit
Reduce modulo two to the register width

label: Simultaneous update
subgoals: Compute every next value from the values before the edge
Update all registers together at the edge
Repeat the update for each clock cycle

label: Enables and synchronous clear
subgoals: Apply the clear first when it is asserted
Load the new value only when the enable is asserted
